sn46.39:1.1: santi bhikkhave, mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā, yehi rukkhā ajjhārūḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti.
sn46.39:1.2: katame ca bhikkhave, mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā, yehi rukkhā ajjhārūḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti seyyathidaṃ:
sn46.39:1.3: assattho nigrodho pilakkho udumbaro kacchako kapitthano.
sn46.39:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā, yehi rukkhā ajjhārūḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti.
sn46.39:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekacco kulaputto yādisake kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so tādisakehi vā kāmehi tato vā pāpiṭṭhatarehi obhaggavibhaggo vipatito seti.
sn46.39:2.1: pañcime bhikkhave, āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhāruhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā.
sn46.39:2.3: kāmacchando bhikkhave, āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhāruho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo
sn46.39:2.4: vyāpādo bhikkhave, āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhāruho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo.
sn46.39:2.5: thinamiddhaṃ bhikkhave, āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso ajjhāruhaṃ paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ.
sn46.39:2.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhikkhave, āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso ajjhāruhaṃ paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ.
sn46.39:2.7: vicikicchā bhikkhave, āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhāruhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā.
sn46.39:2.8: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhāruhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā.
sn46.39:3.1: sattime bhikkhave, bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anajjhāruhā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti.
sn46.39:3.3: satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave, anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anajjhārūho bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimutti phalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati -pe- upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave, anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anajjhāruho bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati.
sn46.39:3.4: ime kho bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anajjhāruhā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattantīti.
